decisions.reason: A classic door lever handle is a durable catalog item with long life cycles in architectural hardware, so withdrawal one year after launch is unlikely.
Door handle families are built to stay in the range for many years to serve architects and specifiers, and there is no sign of failure.
A newly launched design handle needs time to build specification demand, and these firms rarely drop designs after one year.
Like other design handles, it suits a long-lifecycle catalog, and early removal would waste tooling investment.
A handle family supports range breadth and long-term project business, so the firm would keep it.
The L700 electronic access system with distinctive light technology is a strategic step toward digital access, and the firm would keep developing it rather than drop it.
